name: rsskyler-brand
title_zh: 写代码前先过一遍品牌规范，颜色文案组件不跑偏
tagline_zh: 新页面、改样式、挑颜色、写按钮文案——开工前先让它审一遍。专治「看着高级但不像我们」的返工，省下跟设计对线的两小时。
tagline_en: Before you build or restyle any page, let it vet your colors, copy, and components against the brand bible. Kills.
desc_en: Build or review any RSSkyler Limo frontend UI — pages, components, sections, emails, social templates — against the Brand Guidelines Edition 02, 2026. Load this BEFORE writing any JSX, Tailwind class, color value, or user-facing copy for this project. Triggers on: new page or component, restyling, "make it look premium/luxury", choosing a color, adding a CTA, writing headline or button copy, addin
why_zh: 不是事后检查，是前置闸门。把 2026 版规范编成可执行的规则集，在你落笔前拦截违规。
why_en: It's a pre-commit gate, not a linter. Encodes the 2026 guidelines into enforceable rules that stop violations before they hit.
limit_zh: 只认 RSSkyler Limo 这一个项目的 Edition 02 规范；别的品牌或旧版规范它不认。
limit_en: Only enforces RSSkyler Limo Edition 02 brand rules. Ignores other brands/versions. Covers frontend visuals & copy only—no backend, data, or a11y.
title_en: Brand-rule check before you write any JSX or copy
